summary: Implement the RegExp-side Symbol.match protocol method used by String.prototype.match.

target.notes: Non-global matching performs one RegExpExec. Global matching resets lastIndex, repeatedly calls RegExpExec, collects matched strings, and explicitly advances after empty matches using Unicode-aware AdvanceStringIndex.

semantics.global: array of full-match strings or null

caveats: This is the RegExp protocol implementation; String.prototype.match remains owned by the STRING workstream.
